## Summary

Briefly describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security or release hardening

## Testing

Describe the automated and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] `composer test` passes
- [ ] `composer quality` passes
- [ ] New or changed logic is covered by tests
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive payment data, or unredacted logs are included
- [ ] User-facing strings are translatable
- [ ] WooCommerce and standalone-mode impact was considered
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration requirements are documented
